svg.title: StoryCanvas Harness: a composable media-agent runtime
svg.desc: Figure 1. Community video-generation modules enter through Skills and Plugins, are composed by Packs and Profiles, executed by the StoryCanvas kernel, and exposed to current or future hosts with reproducible artifacts and evaluation.
svg.text: StoryCanvas Harness: a composable media-agent runtime
Turn community methods into typed, swappable capabilities while preserving an auditable media DAG.
Solid = implemented path Dashed = extension adapter
